## Notebook16a

```{python}
#| tags: [noclear]
import numpy as np
import polars as pl

from funs import *
from plotnine import *
from polars import col as c
theme_set(theme_minimal())

ub = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taylor-arnold/fds-py-nb/refs/heads/main/"
```





```{python}
us_pop = pl.read_csv("data/us_city_population.csv").drop_nulls()
us_pop
```


```{python}
(
    us_pop
    .pipe(ggplot, aes("lon", "lat"))
    + geom_point()
)
```

```{python}
us_pop = DSGeo.from_latlon(us_pop)
us_pop
```

```{python}
DSGeo.plot(us_pop, crs=5069)
```


```{python}
DSGeo.explore(us_pop, tooltip=[c.city])
```


```{python}
DSGeo.explore(us_pop, tooltip=[c.city], column=c.population)
```

```{python}
state_geo = DSGeo.read_file(ub + "data/acs_state.geojson")
```


```{python}
DSGeo.plot(us_pop, crs=6875)
```

```{python}
DSGeo.plot(state_geo, crs=6875)
```


```{python}
df1 = DSGeo.add_area(state_geo, crs=5069)
```


```{python}
df2 = DSGeo.add_area(state_geo, crs=6875)
```

```{python}
(
    df1
    .join(df2, on="abb")
    .pipe(ggplot, aes("area", "area_right"))
    + geom_point()
    + geom_text_repel(aes(label="abb"))
    + geom_abline()
)
```


```{python}
country_geo = DSGeo.read_file("data/countries_polygons.geojson")
country_geo
```

```{python}
DSGeo.explore(country_geo)
```
